- [x] **T-204** A compute lease on the QA PC: a developer suite and SIA's qa-queue.ps1 each take one lease file before a run, so QA never starts over a developer suite and a developer suite never starts over QA; stale leases (expired, or owner process gone) are reclaimed (session 160) — Opened planner session 150, 2026-09-30. Aaron approved the lease, relayed Aaron -> worktrees-d5 (Clark) -> Atlas, verbatim 'yes'. The ruling is the planner's. WHY: D-065 made the QA PC a developer machine first (pilot: Chisel, agent-dashboard), usable for SIA QA only when no developer suite runs; 'quiet' as a judgement is the thing that fails. SCOPE: (1) ONE helper script, tracked in SIA beside docs/loops/qa-queue.ps1 and copied to the QA PC's user folder the same way (never run from inside a checkout), with take / release / status. Other repos (agent-dashboard) call that copy; there are not two implementations. (2) The lease file lives outside every repo, in a fixed per-machine location, and holds {owner seat, session, pid, pid creation time, started, expires}. Taking it is ATOMIC (create-exclusive). (3) Stale-safe: a lease is reclaimable when expired, or when its pid is gone OR the pid's creation time differs (PID reuse; the gate Relay made binding for kills). (4) qa-queue.ps1 takes the lease for its whole run; while another live lease is held it waits and logs 'QA PC busy: <owner>' with a bounded wait, and never starts over it. (5) It fails closed: an unreadable or malformed lease file counts as HELD and says so, and is never silently ignored. ROWS: a held lease makes a queued QA wait and log the owner; a crashed holder (pid gone) is reclaimed, and so is a reused pid; two concurrent takers yield exactly one winner; a malformed file blocks with a named cause; a mutant with non-atomic take (check-then-write) loses the race row; a mutant that ignores the pid creation time loses the reuse row; the queue is red without the lease check and green with it. The queue-script change needs the machine copies re-copied (qa-launch.md). OUT OF SCOPE: agent-dashboard's own call site (Clark briefs Chisel once this exists). Seat: Forge, after T-203.
